'''Dega Smelting Facility #4-Z3''' was an industrial facility on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dega]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the installation was used by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] who had been hired to kidnap the teenage daughter of a [[Radell Mining Corporation]] executive.
